notes.title: Far Flight 1.0.0.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]New feature:[/b]
[*] Profiles can now be deleted from the profile selection menu
[*] [b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[*] Gauss weapons would stop firing completely under certain circumstances
[*] Ability upgrades were applied more often than intended
[*] Ability upgrades were not correctly restored in a continued run
[*] Field effects created artefacts when pausing and then unpausing the game
[/list]

notes.title: Far Flight 1.0.0.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a short invulnerability time after selecting a level up or new gear
[*] Fixed Queen not dismissing her minions when she dies
[*] Fixed Eagle freezing in place
[*] Fixed the display of the explosion chance
[/list]

notes.title: Far Flight is out now!
notes.content:
Far Flight 1.0 is now available. Here is what you can expect from the game:

[list]
[*][b]Build your own build![/b] There are a lot of weapons and ways to combine the different upgrades you get for your ship in a single run.
[*][b]Fight different factions![/b] Three different factions can be encountered in every run and every faction has a different approach in trying to get rid of you.
[*][b]Enhance your next runs![/b] Every run earns you credits which you can use to gain access to ship and loot improvements.
[*][b]Use different ships and pilots![/b] There are multiple ships and pilots you can combine to change the possible loot and upgrades in your run.
[*][b]Combine items to get even better items![/b] During a run you can combine your items in different ways to either up- or sidegrade your items.
[*][b]Fight stronger enemies in increasing danger levels![/b] Every successful run unlocks a new danger level for you to try your skills against better enemies.
[/list]

notes.title: The Far Flight Demo is here!
notes.content:
The Far Flight Demo is out now. Go and try it out.
[list]
[*] You can fight against the first two factions on the first difficulty.
[*] All starting ships and pilots are available.
[*] All Items and upgrades can be found and used.
[/list]
